messages.subject: Installing r-INLA
parts:

source("http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/givemeINLA.R")
Warning in install.packages(sp) :
  'lib = "C:/Program Files/R/R-3.1.1/library"' is not writable
Error in install.packages(sp) :
